activity.notes: After obtaining the Göttingen Privatdozent title in 1919, Noether developed structural abstract algebra and ring and ideal theory, including her 1921 work. This activity segment is within the Weimar Republic, until her forced emigration in 1933; prior 1915–1918 mathematical physics research is not denied.
